create_function_to_hdf: create a function that writes a pandas DataFrame or Series to an HDF5 file using to_hdf
create_function_read_hdf: create a function that reads a pandas DataFrame or Series from an HDF5 file using read_hdf
build_hdfstore_writer: build an HDFStore writer that puts a DataFrame into an HDF5 file with fixed or table format
build_hdfstore_appender: build an HDFStore appender that appends a DataFrame to an existing table-format HDF5 file
test_hdfstore_select: test HDFStore select with where clause filtering on data columns in a table-format HDF5 file
